reason: README clearly states this plugin provides a Settings page in DeepSeek Harness for managing MCP services configured in cordis.patch.yml, including list/add/edit/delete and real connectivity verification via MCP initialize handshakes. That establishes its primary user-facing purpose as external service orchestration for MCP endpoints, with additional utility features for persistence and status monitoring.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 设置中管理 MCP 服务的静态插件，可对已配置服务进行展示、增删改并执行真实的 MCP initialize 连接检测。
summaries.en: This is a static DSH plugin that adds an MCP service management page in Settings to list, add, edit, delete configured servers, and run real MCP initialize connectivity checks.

capabilities: Lists, adds, edits, deletes MCP server entries and saves changes to cordis.patch.yml
Runs real MCP initialize checks for configured servers (streamable-http and stdio)
Spawns and tests MCP server processes via stdio transport during connectivity checks
Exposes host endpoints for MCP management actions (/dsh-mcp/list, /dsh-mcp/check, /dsh-mcp/save)

reasons.code: The plugin adds a Settings MCP management page that lets users manage MCP server definitions and persists edits, showing it is designed for external service configuration rather than local coding tasks.
The described probe functionality performs real MCP initialize handshakes and includes stdio spawning and streamable-http requests, which introduces higher operational impact than passive UI tools.
Host-side routes and real Node APIs (node:fs, node:os, node:child_process) are documented as part of the plugin’s implementation surface.
